newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westgold has key Mt Edon stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westgold has key Mt Edon stake.

text.p: Westgold Resources NL said on Monday it had acquired a 6.75 percent stake in fellow Western Australian gold producer Mount Edon Gold Mines (Aust) NL.
Westgold chairman Mladen Ninkov said the company's strategy was to use its strong cash position to acquire or add value to assets with high potential.

"Mt Edon certainly fits this description," Ninkov said in a statement issued to announce the fact that Westgold held more than five percent. Under stock exhange rules a company has to reveal its holding once it exceeds five percent.

"It (Mt Edon) has a substantial orebody, significant production and prospective tenements. However, it also has certain problems which need to be addressed before the value of the company can be reflected in the share price," he said.
Mt Edon shares ended steady at A$1.60, valuing the company at A$117.62 million based on 73.51 million shares outstanding.
